queries: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), ratios AS (SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts), 0) AS ratio FROM playlist_counts) SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC, PlaylistId LIMIT 10

WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), ratios AS (SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts WHERE track_count > 0), 0) AS ratio FROM playlist_counts) SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC, PlaylistId LIMIT 10

WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), playlist_ratios AS (SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(track_count) FROM playlist_counts), 0) AS ratio FROM playlist_counts) SELECT PlaylistId, track_count, ratio FROM playlist_ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC, PlaylistId LIMIT 10;

WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), playlist_average AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM playlist_counts) SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, 1.0 * pc.track_count / NULLIF(pa.avg_track_count, 0) AS ratio FROM playlist_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN playlist_average AS pa ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, pc.PlaylistId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average includes playlists with zero tracks.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the average using only playlists that have at least one track.
